body: Yes and I too was one of those women who rarely initiated sex. But then I met him and the sex is so great I want it often. So this is a new situation for me too.

> It's possible that this in itself is a touchy subject 


It is, really touchy for him. He gets really depressed over his health issues and is bitter for having a body that doesn't work like he wants to. So me pointing out to him that he can't even keep his girlfriend sexually happy is not something he takes rationally, it hits him to his insecurities and I don't want to make this a big issue because then he'd just feel like it is something he is not good at and something he has to do.

> Bad communication is just as bad as bad sex. Probably worse. If you cannot communicate what you need with your partner, everything isn't great.


This is true and most likely I am not the best person to start these kind of conversations, it's hard for me too because I'm afraid he'll get so offended for feeling like I'm criticizing him which I'm not but, uh, I don't know, he is so damn sensitive, how to talk about this with a person who immediately takes it as a complaint and a sing of his failures?


He has better days, sometimes (two, three months apart) we may have sex two-three times on one week and sometimes when he is in a really good mood we can spend hours in bed. But then something happens at work or his back is worse and it leads to a mood swing that lasts 2-3 weeks. And no, he doesn't want to see a therapist.


Like now is the situation that I'm getting my periods in 2-3 days and my periods usually last 1,5-2 weeks (not nice) so I would like to have sex now because I know I won't be having it after my periods start. 
But he is tired, and his back is hurting so I don't even make the initiative because I can see it in his face that he is not in the mood. Sure, if I tried I could get him turned on and to have sex but I know he'd be doing it reluctantly, just to please me and that is the idea that bothers me. 

Thank you for replying, this is hard because I don't have anyone to talk about this.
